identity: University of Amsterdam BSc Geneeskunde, RIO 56551, programme registry row 413. Dutch-taught 180 EC Epicurus programme. No separately selected formal route; the elective pathway is part of year two.
sourceUse: The UvA study programme supplies the component credits. The dated 2026–27 assessment plan corroborates the clinical themes and professional and academic strands; its third-year choice reference does not establish a second additional credit block. UvA progression guidance and its linked 2026 handout establish formal progression and thesis preparation.
components: Patient-centred theme covering pregnancy, birth, and physical and sexual development.
Patient-centred theme covering the nervous system, eye and ear, and musculoskeletal system.
Patient-centred theme covering metabolic, hormonal and immunological regulation.
Patient-centred theme covering cardiovascular, pulmonary and renal systems.
Clinical epidemiology, statistics and evidence-based medicine.
Academic skills, scientific skills and humanities portfolio work.
Patient-centred study of autoimmune disease and endocrine and digestive-system disorders.
Patient-centred study of arrhythmia, coagulation disorders, pulmonary embolism and renal failure.
Choose a listed 12-week pathway or assemble an approved individual pathway, with study abroad possible.
Write a medical bachelor’s thesis after passing Klinische en Wetenschappelijke Methodologie.
Patient-centred study of complex orthopaedics, central functional disorders and psychiatric disorders.
Human development from embryo through older age, with population health, the older patient and the health-care system.
Final bachelor block in clinical reasoning and practical skills before master’s clerkships.

progression.year-two: For direct progression, at least 48 first-year EC including academic and professional strands and completion of all required first-year teaching.
progression.year-three: For progression with second-year blocks outstanding, pass all first-year units, the second-year academic and professional strands and complete all compulsory second-year teaching.
progression.thesis: Pass Klinische en Wetenschappelijke Methodologie before starting the 12 EC thesis.
progression.practice: 14 EC Opmaat naar de praktijk is the final undergraduate clinical-skills block before master’s clerkships.
